participation.context: Said he was not in the afternoon's play and stayed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the board at threepence and kept the letter off any carrier.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Showed the loaf still short of the notch.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You did not go back for the Knave. You ate, and you left the letter in the house.
